name: microsoft-sql-vscode
description: Thirty-six skills curated for application development and database lifecycle work with the MSSQL extension in Visual Studio Code: connections and drivers, schema and ORMs, deployment and provisioning, diagnostics and security, data movement and recovery, T-SQL, vector search and RAG, Azure Functions bindings, and database projects. Data API Builder skills are omitted to avoid conflicting with the extension's agent tools.
